newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE assigns "PR1+" rating to HSAL.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE assigns "PR1+" rating to HSAL.

text.p: India's Credit Analysis & Research Ltd.(CARE) has assigned a "PR1+" rating to the 200 million rupees commercial paper programme of Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Ltd. (HSAL), it said on Thursday.
HSAL was incorporated in 1994, to take over the agro-chemical division of Hoechst India Ltd., which has been in the agro-chemical business since 1984, CARE said in a statement.
HSAL is a subsidiary of Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Gmbh, the world's second largest agro-chemical company, with a total income of about DM 3.4 billion rupees, during FY'96, the statement added.
